condition: Right lower lobe pneumonia presenting as abdominal pain (child)
summary: 9-year-old boy with 2 days of fever and right-sided abdominal pain, one vomit and a mild cough; RR 34, HR 128, T 39.1, SpO₂ 94 %, soft abdomen, crackles at the right base. Appendicitis mimic.

inputs.hpi: Referred by the GP as ?appendicitis. Two days of high fevers and pain in the right side of the tummy, vomited once, a mild cough. Mother notes fast breathing. Opened bowels normally yesterday. Eating a little.

exam.abdomen: Soft, mild right upper tenderness on deep inspiration, no guarding, no rebound, not tender at McBurney's point.
exam.respiratory: Reduced breath sounds and crackles at the right base, RR 34.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right lower lobe pneumonia
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Right lower lobe pneumonia presenting as right-sided abdominal pain; appendicitis unlikely (soft abdomen, chest signs).

mustNotMiss.knownGapNote: Web run 2026-09-25: not in top 3 of web.pane: 1. Acute Cholecystitis | 2. Acute Cholangitis | 3. Acute Appendicitis. PANE has no pneumonia node.
mustNotMiss.proposedFix: lib/pane-engine: add a community-acquired pneumonia node (productive cough, fever, pleuritic pain, focal crackles/bronchial breathing, hypoxia) with a protocol (CURB65/CRB65 severity, CXR, amoxicillin for low severity, blood cultures + IV co-amoxiclav/clarithromycin for high severity) and map J18/J15.

mustInclude.note: Diagnosis in doubt (abdominal presentation): CXR indicated.

mustExclude.note: Wrong procedure for a chest cause of abdominal pain.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: Web run 2026-09-25: forbidden management item present in web.clinicalPrompts: "• emergency laparoscopic appendicectomy - consent obtained, theatre booked." (+1 more).
mustExclude.proposedFix: Gate the appendicectomy operative-plan cascade on the working diagnosis (see HPB findings gap 1) and a negation-aware exam matcher ("no guarding").

mustExclude.note: Wrong procedure in a 9-year-old with pneumonia.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: Web run 2026-09-25: forbidden management item present in web.managementPanel: "[surgical] early laparoscopic cholecystectomy within 72 h (grade i-ii)." (+2 more).
mustExclude.proposedFix: The Assessment panel follows the PANE top (cholecystitis 0.299) instead of the confirmed diagnosis (J18.1); prefer the locked working diagnosis (HPB findings gap 7).

guideline.name: BTS guidelines for the management of community acquired pneumonia in children: update 2011
guideline.section: Clinical features: fever with tachypnoea and increased work of breathing; lower-lobe pneumonia can present with abdominal pain; CXR not routine in the community but indicated when the diagnosis is in doubt or the child is admitted
guideline.citation: Harris M, Clark J, Coote N, et al. Thorax. 2011;66(Suppl 2):ii1-23.

rationale: Paediatric mimic: basal pneumonia referred as appendicitis. Every engine that routes by "abdominal pain" is expected to reach for appendicitis; the chest signs and tachypnoea should redirect.
